edges.reason: transfer delegates balance movement to internal _transfer.
transferFrom performs the transfer through _transfer.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance via _approve.
approve writes the allowance through _approve.
burn destroys caller balance via _burn.
increaseAllowance rewrites allowance via _approve.
decreaseAllowance rewrites allowance via _approve.
_burnFrom burns the account balance first.
_burnFrom then reduces the allowance via _approve.
withdraw forwards all arguments to internalWithdraw.
batchWithdraw loops calling internalWithdraw for each entry.
internalWithdraw enforces authorisation through isWithdrawAuthorised before minting.
internalWithdraw mints new tokens once signature checks pass.
Authorisation digest is constructed by withdrawAccessor.
isWithdrawAuthorised relies on ecrecover-based signature recovery.
Recovered signer is compared against the accessAuthority state variable.
Authorisation string embeds msg.sender, binding the signature to the caller.
Minted tokens are credited to msg.sender inside internalWithdraw.
Contract balance is forwarded to the caller-supplied msg.sender address.
transferBalance executes an unbounded low-level value call to msg.sender.
The recipient of the low-level call can re-enter HolyToken during value transfer.
_mint increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
_mint adds the amount to the recipient balance in _balances.
_transfer subtracts from sender and adds to recipient in _balances.
_burn decreases the account balance in _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
internalWithdraw records the used transaction id in _transactions.
internalWithdraw reads _transactions to reject already-used ids.
setAccessAuthority overwrites the signature authority stored in accessAuthority.
setAccessAuthority is gated by the onlyOwner check on _owner.
setMaxSupply overwrites the maxSupply cap.
setMaxSupply is gated by the onlyOwner check on _owner.
transferBalance is restricted to the owner recorded in _owner.
internalWithdraw enforces totalSupply + amount <= maxSupply.
internalWithdraw queries totalSupply() for its supply cap check.
Withdrawal id parameter flows into internalWithdraw state lookups.
Requested amount parameter is minted and stored by internalWithdraw.
Caller-supplied signature is passed into the authorisation check.
addr parameter becomes the new accessAuthority.
newMaxSupply parameter becomes the new supply cap.
success local captures the result of the low-level value call.
messageHash local is the digest supplied to ECDSA.recover.
_approve writes the new amount into _allowances.
transferFrom reads the current allowance from _allowances before debiting.
getTransactionAmount returns the recorded amount from _transactions.
balanceOf reads the account balance from _balances.

normalization_plan.reason: The withdraw id parameter only exists to index _transactions inside internalWithdraw.
numberOfTokens is a per-call amount consumed entirely by internalWithdraw mint/cap logic.
The signature parameter is only meaningful as the input to ecrecover-based authorisation.
addr is the sole argument written to accessAuthority by setAccessAuthority.
newMaxSupply is the sole argument written to maxSupply by setMaxSupply.
success is only the return flag of the low-level balance transfer call.
messageHash is an intermediate digest used exclusively by ECDSA.recover.
